sources.title: Pd Api Multi Dataset
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Planning Data explicitly supports multiple dataset parameters in one point query.

sources.title: Pd Api Point Intersection
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The API returns entities whose geometry intersects the supplied point.

sources.title: Pd Api Wgs84
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Coordinates are supplied in WGS84 / EPSG:4326.

sources.title: Pd Api Fields
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Field filters can restrict responses to name, dataset, reference and other needed attributes.

sources.title: Pd Api Absence Caveat
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: An empty response is not proof of no constraints because data coverage varies.

sources.title: Pd Api No Batch
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: There is no batch endpoint; issue one request per property.

sources.title: Pd Api Rate Limit
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Planning Data advises polite rate-limiting between property requests.

sources.title: Pd Api Bulk
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: For large portfolios, bulk downloads and local intersections are recommended for a stable snapshot.

promotion_gate: This prepares a single exact-point screen per candidate across high-value constraint datasets; result promotion waits for actual response capture and hash/UTC evidence.
